glyph.isekai_mahou.quarry.desc: Digs a square area (7×7) layer by layer, going down and remembering where it stopped. Breaks a few blocks at a time (Amplify: more) and pays mana per block by hardness. Items go to the Arcane Collector/pedestal chests (by hand: to you). Never breaks chests, bedrock or protected areas. Stops 48 layers down (Extend: deeper; Persistent: to the bottom of the world) or at bedrock. Pedestal filter: digs only that block (with Invert: everything but it).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lumberjack.desc: Fells whole trees in the area (trunk, branches and natural leaves) and replants a sapling at the base. The sapling comes from the pedestal filter (by hand: your off hand), the leaves themselves or the chests. 1 tree at a time (Amplify: more). Wooden houses without natural leaves stay standing.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_fishing.desc: Fishes in the area's water (needs 6+ source blocks) with an angler's luck: fish and some finds. Each pond gives a fish every 4 s. Amplify: more tries; Fortune: Luck of the Sea III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.illuminate.desc: Places torches (or another light from your inventory/the pedestal chests) on the dark spots of the area, spaced out, so monsters don't spawn. Pedestal filter / off hand: uses only that light.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_ripe.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts when there are ripe crops in the area. By hand: the spell only goes off if something ripe is near you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_empty.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts when there is empty farmland (or soul sand) in the area. Great with Sow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_items.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts when there are loose items in the area. Great with Collect and Arcane Forge.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_work.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts when some effect of the spell has something to do (the Quarry hasn't hit bottom, there's a tree, water, a dark spot, a ripe crop, empty soil, items...). Saves mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_night.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts while it is night (never in the Nether/End).
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_day.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts while it is day (never in the Nether/End).
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_monsters.desc: Pedestal trigger: only casts when there is a monster in the area. For defense towers and mob farms.
message.isekai_mahou.auto_glyphs.no_work: Not enough mana to keep working.
message.isekai_mahou.auto_glyphs.fishing: Needs at least %s still water blocks to fish.
message.isekai_mahou.auto_glyphs.no_ligh: No torches (or other light) to place.
